chain_words.nuance: a small adjustment that changes very little
makes something more precise through careful adjustment
general sense of making something better
raises the quality or value of something noticeably
changes something so completely that it becomes a different thing

explanation: These words all describe making something better, but with increasing degrees of change, from a minor adjustment to a complete transformation.

usage_notes.difference: 'Improve' means to make something better in general, while 'enhance' suggests adding value or quality that makes the thing more attractive or effective.
